texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 2.3 Registration in the Participant Register: why register?
texts.text: 2.3 Registration in the Participant Register: why register?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Any economic operator  willing to submit a tender for this call for tenders must be registered in  the  Participant  Register  -  an  online  register  of  organizations  and  natural  persons participating in European Commission's calls for tenders or proposals  (participants).
texts.text: Any economic operator  willing to submit a tender for this call for tenders must be registered in  the  Participant  Register  -  an  online  register  of  organizations  and  natural  persons participating in European Commission's calls for tenders or proposals  (participants).

texts.label: text
texts.orig: On registering each participant obtains a Participant Identification Code (PIC, 9-digit number) which acts as its unique identifier in the Participant Register.  A participant needs to register only once -the information provided can be further updated or re-used by the participant in other European Chemicals Agency's calls for tenders.
